# Graphics harness fixtures

`pngsuite-exif2c08.png.b64` is the Base64 representation of PNGSuite's
`exif2c08.png`: a 32×32 truecolour PNG carrying an `eXIf` ancillary chunk. It
is stored as text so fixtures remain inspectable in ordinary diffs; tests decode
it before handing it to the PNG decoder.

Source: [`lunapaint/pngsuite`](https://github.com/lunapaint/pngsuite) commit
`8cd768dd0d0063195174d0d01cacbd5a7d1e5605`, blob
`56eb734991497525b489b9baaf275d2e71d25683`. Decoded SHA-256:
`d04140d74bc60597c47b5aac371a3553d3add9354437bbd8c57007d94e197809`.
